basic_instruction_candidates.name: LOAD
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Read the valid logical tensor window using shape/stride; define padding without out-of-range reads
acceptance_to_add: FP8 physical byte loads separately from carrier loads

basic_instruction_candidates.name: STORE
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Write only the valid destination region; preserve all other elements

basic_instruction_candidates.name: COPY
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Exact data copy; alias binding alone does not provide this behavior

basic_instruction_candidates.name: EXTRACT
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Copy a valid source window; source unchanged; preserve dtype and bits; independent destination storage
basic_instruction_candidates.evidence_level: supporting_operator_window_cases_only; not named PTO instruction conformance
basic_instruction_candidates.native_lowering_attribution: not established for a specific TEXTRACT/TINSERT instruction
basic_instruction_candidates.standalone_opcode: optional; architecture mapping may use an offset COPY, legal load/store composition or a proven-equivalent Tile subview
window_contract: offset is in logical element coordinates
shape/valid and strides determine the element mapping
window must fit permitted source/destination valid bounds
source and destination storage must be disjoint in this baseline; overlapping transfer is invalid
acceptance_to_add: noncontiguous physical strides and tail valid extents

basic_instruction_candidates.name: INSERT
basic_instruction_candidates.output: Destination Tile<T> updated only within the selected window
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Copy the valid source region into a destination window; source unchanged; preserve all destination elements outside the window
basic_instruction_candidates.evidence_level: supporting_operator_window_cases_only; not named PTO instruction conformance
basic_instruction_candidates.native_lowering_attribution: not established for a specific TEXTRACT/TINSERT instruction
basic_instruction_candidates.standalone_opcode: optional; architecture mapping may use an offset COPY, legal load/store composition or a proven-equivalent Tile subview
window_contract: offset is in logical element coordinates
shape/valid and strides determine the element mapping
window must fit permitted source/destination valid bounds
source and destination storage must be disjoint in this baseline; overlapping transfer is invalid
acceptance_to_add: noncontiguous physical strides and tail valid extents
destination outside window unchanged; source unchanged

basic_instruction_candidates.name: FILL
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Fill with the specified value, including zero or a reduction neutral element
acceptance_to_add: padding does not enter reductions incorrectly
basic_instruction_candidates.standalone_opcode: optional; compiler or load padding may provide the function

basic_instruction_candidates.name: TRANSPOSE
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Preserve elements under the specified axis permutation; may be absorbed by layout/addressing when valid

basic_instruction_candidates.name: ADD
basic_instruction_candidates.output: Tile of same logical result shape
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: a + b; preserve source cast boundaries; scalar left/right forms can be composed using FILL
acceptance_to_add: exact index/address arithmetic, including range and overflow; FP32 coordinate carriers in the prototype do not prescribe LPU index dtype

basic_instruction_candidates.name: SUB
basic_instruction_candidates.output: Tile of same logical result shape
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: a - b; preserve source cast boundaries; scalar left/right forms can be composed using FILL
acceptance_to_add: exact index/address arithmetic, including range and overflow; FP32 coordinate carriers in the prototype do not prescribe LPU index dtype

basic_instruction_candidates.name: MUL
basic_instruction_candidates.output: Tile of same logical result shape
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: a * b; preserve source cast boundaries; scalar left/right forms can be composed using FILL
acceptance_to_add: exact index/address arithmetic, including range and overflow; FP32 coordinate carriers in the prototype do not prescribe LPU index dtype

basic_instruction_candidates.name: DIV
basic_instruction_candidates.output: Tile of same logical result shape
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: a / b; preserve source cast boundaries; scalar left/right forms can be composed using FILL
acceptance_to_add: reciprocal implementation must meet the numerical contract

basic_instruction_candidates.name: ABS
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Elementwise absolute value

basic_instruction_candidates.name: MIN_MAX
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Elementwise min/max, including scalar clamp bounds

basic_instruction_candidates.name: CMP
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Produce logical comparison results; include ==, <, >= and >

basic_instruction_candidates.name: SELECT
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Select each logical element from the appropriate input, preserving operand offsets

basic_instruction_candidates.name: REDUCE_SUM
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Sum along a nonempty valid logical axis; combine partial sums across tiles

basic_instruction_candidates.name: REDUCE_MAX
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Maximum over the valid nonempty logical axis; amax uses ABS first

basic_instruction_candidates.name: BROADCAST
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Reuse scalar, row or column values over target axes while preserving Token/head and source offset
basic_instruction_candidates.standalone_opcode: optional; arithmetic access mode or compiler view may implement broadcasting

basic_instruction_candidates.name: MMA_BF16
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: acc_out = acc_in + A@B over valid M/N/K; separate final output conversion; represent split-K partial sums
acceptance_to_add: BF16 cast before Attention scaling or next Linear as required

basic_instruction_candidates.name: MMA_FP8
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: FP8 value dot product with FP32 accumulation; do not merge differently scaled K-groups before applying their scales
basic_instruction_candidates.evidence_note: Value semantics supported by bf16_carrier; direct A5 FP8 instruction remains unvalidated

basic_instruction_candidates.name: CVT
basic_instruction_candidates.output: Tile<dst_dtype> with same valid logical elements
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Convert numeric type at the source-defined boundary; FP8 narrowing uses clamped finite input and nearest ties-to-even with signed zero
basic_instruction_candidates.evidence_note: FP8 encoded values validated by carrier arithmetic; hardware FP8 TCVT not established

basic_instruction_candidates.name: EXP
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: exp(x)

basic_instruction_candidates.name: LOG
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: log(x), x>0

basic_instruction_candidates.name: RSQRT
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: 1/sqrt(x), x>0; eps added by caller

basic_instruction_candidates.name: FLOOR
basic_instruction_candidates.output: Integral-valued Tile<FP32> or equivalent conversion composition
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Floor nonnegative interpolation/window coordinates before index conversion; exact integer division/remainder or scalar address generation may replace this combination

basic_instruction_candidates.name: IOTA
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Generate exact logical serial indices; may be a load/precompute rather than a dedicated opcode
basic_instruction_candidates.standalone_opcode: optional; scalar control/compiler/precomputed data may provide indices

basic_instruction_candidates.name: INDEX_ALU
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Exact integer add/sub/mul and nonnegative floor-div/rem for pixel windows, grid and merge ordering; division/rem may be composed or precomputed
dtypes: logical integer indices; physical width deferred
acceptance_to_add: large-index exactness beyond current small cases
basic_instruction_candidates.evidence_note: Current kernel uses FP32/floor composition for coordinates; arbitrary-range integer division is not validated

basic_instruction_candidates.name: GATHER_ROW
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Read table[idx[r],:] in index order; scalar pixels are rows with H=1; also reorder Conv3D output rows into spatial merge groups. Keep index/position associations.
acceptance_to_add: logical memory-row addressing vs tile-local gather
scalar pixel windows across C/T/H/W and batch
overlapping Conv3D windows and non-square strides
lowering_choices: TGATHER only when the relevant source is already in a Tile

basic_instruction_candidates.name: SCATTER_ROW
basic_instruction_candidates.semantics: Unique valid indices overwrite full rows; preserve all unselected destination elements; OP-13 copies text to output first
acceptance_to_add: reject invalid/duplicate indices at current interface
lowering_choices: TSCATTER when updating an in-tile destination
basic_instruction_candidates.atomic_requirement: none from A-group; MoE accumulation belongs to B-group consolidation

fusion_candidates.name: DYN_QUANT_K128
fusion_candidates.semantics: BF16 activation -> E4M3FN payload and FP32 scale per Token/K128
contracts: RNE, signed zero and zero-padded K tail

fusion_candidates.name: SCALED_MMA_FP8
fusion_candidates.semantics: acc32 += (dot32 * sx[m,g]) * fp32(sw[nblock,g]); BF16 final output
contracts: BF16 checkpoint scale per N128/K128 weight block

fusion_candidates.name: NORM
fusion_candidates.semantics: LayerNorm, Q/K L2Norm and gated RMSNorm with distinct axes/affine/cast contracts
contracts: BF16 normalized and weighted boundaries in gated Norm

fusion_candidates.name: SOFTMAX
fusion_candidates.semantics: FP32 stable Softmax within one attention segment -> BF16 probability

fusion_candidates.name: GELU
fusion_candidates.semantics: Separate source GELU(tanh) and GELU(erf); current kernel composes exp/arithmetic/polynomial approximations

fusion_candidates.name: CAUSAL_DWCONV1D
fusion_candidates.semantics: History-window tap accumulation in FP32 -> BF16 Conv output -> SiLU -> BF16

fusion_candidates.name: FP32_GEMV_OUTER
fusion_candidates.semantics: State^T @ key and key outer delta; FP32 throughout
contracts: no narrowing of State/key to BF16
chunk pairwise and State-matrix products also use FP32 MUL+REDUCE_SUM; evaluate wider FP32 matrix capability during mapping
comparison_axes: vector composition vs FP32 matrix capability

fusion_candidates.name: DELTA_STATE_UPDATE
fusion_candidates.semantics: Decay -> prediction -> beta-weighted delta -> outer update -> readout
contracts: return FP32 State and BF16 output without modifying input State

fusion_candidates.name: PREFIX_SUM
fusion_candidates.semantics: Inclusive FP32 sum along the valid Token axis, reset at every chunk

fusion_candidates.name: TRIANGULAR_MASK
fusion_candidates.semantics: Keep j <= i, including the diagonal; use -inf before EXP for invalid log-decay entries
contracts: current HW PyPTO path compares FP32 local positions; this does not replace exact LPU index semantics

fusion_candidates.name: TRIANGULAR_SOLVE
fusion_candidates.semantics: Solve (I + strict_lower(A)) X = RHS in FP32 by forward substitution
contracts: two independent RHS widths K and V
comparison_axes: forward-substitution vector composition vs specialized solve

fusion_candidates.name: IMG2COL_3D
fusion_candidates.semantics: Pixels[B,C,T,H,W] -> windows[B*Ot*Oh*Ow,C*Kt*Kh*Kw] in C,Kt,Kh,Kw order; window transformation only, followed by separate MMA and bias
contracts: input cast before window multiply; overlapping windows are repeated reads
comparison_axes: full window materialization vs on-demand operand feed
temporary storage and matrix input layout
fusion_candidates.pto_mapping_note: PTO TIMG2COL is a possible native lowering with layout/temporal constraints; the current kernel validates the composed im2col semantics, not a standalone TIMG2COL instruction.
fusion_candidates.current_implementation: Explicit im2col function composing coordinates and device gather; its result feeds pl.matmul and FP32 bias. No coarse Conv invocation.

programming_model_requirements.name: tile_type_valid_shape_layout
programming_model_requirements.semantics: Typed Tile values have logical shape, valid extent and layout; memory capacity and physical allocation are separate

programming_model_requirements.name: view_slice_and_materialization
programming_model_requirements.semantics: Slice views alias source storage and preserve offset/stride; EXTRACT copy semantics produce independent storage; declare window shape/valid/layout mapping

programming_model_requirements.name: writes_accumulators_and_aliases
programming_model_requirements.semantics: INSERT updates only its window; preserve the rest of destination and read-only State/history inputs; COPY/EXTRACT are distinct from alias binding; overlapping source/destination transfer is invalid in this baseline

programming_model_requirements.name: associated_multiple_outputs
programming_model_requirements.semantics: Keep quantization payload/scale, position index/weight and GDN output/State/history separately typed and associated

programming_model_requirements.name: dependencies_completion_and_lifetime
programming_model_requirements.semantics: Producer completion before reads, last-use completion before reuse, ordered Token/chunk State commits; State and Conv history describe the same consumed prefix

programming_model_requirements.name: scalar_control_and_function_scope
programming_model_requirements.semantics: Shape/metadata specialization and unrolling are allowed; runtime control placement is deferred; function names shadow rather than overwrite caller bindings
